entities.summary: Tina Asatiani was an Armenian physicist of Georgian origin. Academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Armenia (1996), doctor of physical and mathematical sciences (1971), professor (1974). Honored Worker of Science and Technology of the Armenian SSR (1980). Winner of the Lenin Prize (1970). Founder of the Georgian charity community in Armenia, "Iveria."
